scripts.lint:md: set -o pipefail; git ls-files -zco --exclude-standard '*.md' | xargs -0 -r npx markdownlint --ignore-path .markdownlintignore
scripts.lint:md:fix: set -o pipefail; git ls-files -zco --exclude-standard '*.md' | xargs -0 -r npx markdownlint --ignore-path .markdownlintignore --fix
scripts.lint:text: set -o pipefail; git ls-files -zco --exclude-standard '*.md' | xargs -0 -r npx textlint --ignore-path .textlintignore
scripts.lint:text:fix: set -o pipefail; git ls-files -zco --exclude-standard '*.md' | xargs -0 -r npx textlint --ignore-path .textlintignore --fix
scripts.lint:links: set -o pipefail; git ls-files -zco --exclude-standard '*.md' | xargs -0 -I {} markdown-link-check ./{} --config .markdown-link-check.json --quiet
scripts.lint:links:verbose: set -o pipefail; git ls-files -zco --exclude-standard '*.md' | xargs -0 -I {} markdown-link-check ./{} --config .markdown-link-check.json
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:md && npm run lint:text
scripts.lint:all:fix: npm run lint:md:fix && npm run lint:text:fix
